items.title: 3 Cash-Heavy Stocks on Our Watchlist
items.summary: Companies with more cash than debt often have stronger financial flexibility, making them attractive in uncertain markets. With interest payments less of a worry, these businesses can invest more in growth, innovation, or buybacks and dividends.

items.title: Is D-Wave Quantum’s (QBTS) AT&T Win Quietly Redefining Its Competitive Edge In Enterprise Computing?
items.summary: D-Wave Quantum’s recent past announcement that it was added to the NASDAQ Composite Index followed news that AT&T would expand its use of the company’s quantum computing technology across multiple network operations workflows. AT&T reported cutting a key network optimization workload from about one hour to less than 15 seconds using D-Wave’s annealing-based system, underscoring the technology’s operational impact.
